cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. A chair won't hurt while the calculation finishes being pessimistic.

beats.speaker: A
